decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Site Location Plan, 311/5, 311/4 GILB 1, 311/4 GILB 2. Received: 15/03/2025.
Unnumbered Fire Statement. Received: 31/03/2025.
Unnumbered Transport Statement. Received: 08/07/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side and rear elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Delivery & Servicing Plan hereby approved shall be fully implemented and maintained for the lifetime of the development. 
Reason: In the interests of the safety of pedestrians and vehicles, to protect neighbours' living conditions and to support sustainable transport objectives and road safety.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Transport Statement hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the timescales specified therein, to include those parts identified as being implemented before and following occupation, unless alternative timescales are agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. The approved Travel Plan shall be monitored and reviewed in accordance with the agreed Travel Plan targets and timescales to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: In order to promote sustainable modes of transport.

Condition : 7 - The premises shall be used for retail use (Use Class E(a)) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E (Commercial, Business and Service) of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), nor in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Reason: The Council is satisfied that the use hereby permitted would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use within the same Use Class to protect nearby land uses and the character of the area.

Condition : 8 - The access doorway to the approved retail unit shall have: a minimum clear width of 900mm; a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor not exceeding a gradient of 1:12; a door handle set no more than one metre above ground level and a 400 mm high steel 'kick plate' suitable for the needs of wheelchair users or shall be automatic opening.  In cases where the door has no frame and is part of a fully glazed frontage, the door and glazed frontage hereby approved shall be clearly defined with visual manifestations on the glass at two levels: between 850mm to 1000mm and 1400mm to 1600mm above ground level. The manifestations shall be fixed to, painted on or etched into the glass in the form of a continuous or broken (by no more than 20 mm) horizontal band 50 mm high, or a series of signs or logos at least 150mm high spaced no further than 300 mm apart.  The manifestations shall visually contrast with their surroundings when viewed from both inside and outside the building in all lighting conditions.  
Reason: In order to ensure that the development complies with inclusive design principles.
description: Subdivision of existing office to create retail unit and alterations to the front elevation with the installations of new glazed door, fixed screening and security shutter.
subdivision_of_building: Elevation to 4 gilbert street hounslow at ground floor level

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: The retail unit is only approx 10m2 & recycling and general waste will be collected and disposed of by landlord ( property owner ) via  a commercial provider. Note no food preparation or waste in the retail unit
